mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mail ( sender_id, subject, content, send_time, has_attachment, is_spam, priority, mail_status, sender_deleted ) VALUES ( #{senderId}, #{subject}, #{content}, NOW(), #{hasAttachment}, #{spam}, #{priority}, #{mailStatus}, #{senderDeleted} )
mapper.select: SELECT m.mail_id, m.sender_id, u.username AS sender_name, u.email AS sender_email, m.subject, CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(IFNULL(m.content, '')) > 50 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(m.content, 50), '...') ELSE m.content END AS preview, mr.is_read, m.has_attachment, mr.receive_time, m.send_time, m.priority, m.is_spam FROM mail_receiver mr JOIN mail m ON mr.mail_id = m.mail_id JOIN `user` u ON m.sender_id = u.user_id WHERE mr.receiver_id = #{userId} AND mr.is_deleted = FALSE AND m.mail_status = 1 ORDER BY m.send_time DESC

SELECT m.mail_id, m.sender_id, u.username AS sender_name, u.email AS sender_email, m.subject, CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(IFNULL(m.content, '')) > 50 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(m.content, 50), '...') ELSE m.content END AS preview, m.has_attachment, m.send_time, m.priority, m.is_spam FROM mail m JOIN `user` u ON m.sender_id = u.user_id WHERE m.sender_id = #{userId} AND m.sender_deleted = FALSE AND m.mail_status = 1 ORDER BY m.send_time DESC

SELECT DISTINCT m.mail_id, m.sender_id, u.username AS sender_name, u.email AS sender_email, m.subject, CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(IFNULL(m.content, '')) > 50 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(m.content, 50), '...') ELSE m.content END AS preview, mr.is_read, m.has_attachment, mr.receive_time, m.send_time, m.priority, m.is_spam FROM mail m JOIN `user` u ON m.sender_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN mail_receiver mr ON mr.mail_id = m.mail_id AND mr.receiver_id = #{userId} WHERE m.mail_status = 1 AND ( (m.sender_id = #{userId} AND m.sender_deleted = TRUE) OR mr.is_deleted = TRUE ) ORDER BY m.send_time DESC

SELECT u.username FROM mail_receiver mr JOIN `user` u ON mr.receiver_id = u.user_id WHERE mr.mail_id = #{mailId} AND mr.receiver_type IN ('TO', 'CC') ORDER BY FIELD(mr.receiver_type, 'TO', 'CC'), u.email

SELECT u.email FROM mail_receiver mr JOIN `user` u ON mr.receiver_id = u.user_id WHERE mr.mail_id = #{mailId} AND mr.receiver_type IN ('TO', 'CC') ORDER BY FIELD(mr.receiver_type, 'TO', 'CC'), u.email

SELECT m.mail_id, m.sender_id, u.username AS sender_name, u.email AS sender_email, m.subject, m.content, m.send_time, m.has_attachment, m.priority, m.is_spam, sr.spam_type, sr.reason FROM mail m JOIN `user` u ON m.sender_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN spam_record sr ON sr.mail_id = m.mail_id WHERE m.mail_id = #{mailId} AND m.mail_status = 1
SELECT u.email FROM mail_receiver mr JOIN `user` u ON mr.receiver_id = u.user_id WHERE mr.mail_id = #{mailId} AND mr.receiver_type = 'TO' ORDER BY u.email
SELECT u.email FROM mail_receiver mr JOIN `user` u ON mr.receiver_id = u.user_id WHERE mr.mail_id = #{mailId} AND mr.receiver_type = 'CC' ORDER BY u.email
SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM mail_receiver mr JOIN mail m ON mr.mail_id = m.mail_id WHERE mr.mail_id = #{mailId} AND mr.receiver_id = #{userId} AND mr.is_deleted = FALSE AND m.mail_status = 1
SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM mail WHERE mail_id = #{mailId} AND sender_deleted = TRUE AND mail_status = 1
SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM mail_receiver mr JOIN mail m ON mr.mail_id = m.mail_id WHERE mr.mail_id = #{mailId} AND mr.receiver_id = #{userId} AND mr.is_deleted = TRUE AND m.mail_status = 1
SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM mail_receiver mr JOIN mail m ON mr.mail_id = m.mail_id WHERE mr.mail_id = #{mailId} AND mr.is_deleted = FALSE AND m.mail_status = 1

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mail_star ms WHERE ms.user_id=#{userId} AND ms.mail_id=m.mail_id) is_starred,m.delivery_status,m.mail_id,m.sender_id,u.username sender_name,u.email sender_email,m.subject, LEFT(m.content,50) preview,m.has_attachment,m.send_time,m.priority,m.is_spam, NULL is_read,NULL receive_time mr.is_read,mr.receive_time FROM mail m JOIN user u ON u.user_id=m.sender_id LEFT JOIN mail_receiver mr ON mr.mail_id=m.mail_id AND mr.receiver_id=#{userId} WHERE m.mail_status=1
AND m.sender_id=#{userId} AND m.sender_deleted=FALSE AND ((m.sender_id=#{userId} AND m.sender_deleted=TRUE) OR mr.is_deleted=TRUE) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mail_star s WHERE s.mail_id=m.mail_id AND s.user_id=#{userId}) AND ((m.sender_id=#{userId} AND m.sender_deleted=FALSE) OR mr.is_deleted=FALSE) AND mr.receiver_id=#{userId} AND mr.is_deleted=FALSE AND m.is_spam=TRUEAND m.is_spam=FALSE
AND (mr.receive_time < #{time} OR (mr.receive_time=#{time} AND mr.mail_id < #{id})) ORDER BY mr.receive_time DESC,mr.mail_id DESC
AND (m.send_time < #{time} OR (m.send_time=#{time} AND m.mail_id < #{id})) ORDER BY m.send_time DESC,m.mail_id DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT mr.mail_id,u.username,u.email FROM mail_receiver mr JOIN user u ON u.user_id=mr.receiver_id WHERE mr.receiver_type IN ('TO','CC') AND mr.mail_id IN #{id} ORDER BY mr.mail_id,FIELD(mr.receiver_type,'TO','CC'),u.email

SELECT mr.is_read,mr.receive_time,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mail_star ms WHERE ms.user_id=#{userId} AND ms.mail_id=m.mail_id) is_starred,m.mail_id,m.sender_id,m.subject,LEFT(m.content,50) preview,m.send_time,m.has_attachment,m.priority,m.is_spam, u.username sender_name,u.email sender_email,p.score priority_score FROM mail_priority_score p JOIN mail m ON m.mail_id=p.mail_id JOIN user u ON u.user_id=m.sender_id LEFT JOIN mail_receiver mr ON mr.mail_id=m.mail_id AND mr.receiver_id=#{userId} WHERE p.user_id=#{userId} AND m.mail_status=1 AND m.sender_id=#{userId} AND m.sender_deleted=FALSE AND ((m.sender_id=#{userId} AND m.sender_deleted=TRUE) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mail_receiver mr WHERE mr.mail_id=m.mail_id AND mr.receiver_id=#{userId} AND mr.is_deleted=TRUE)) AND m.is_spam=FALSE AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mail_receiver mr WHERE mr.mail_id=m.mail_id AND mr.receiver_id=#{userId} AND mr.is_deleted=FALSE) AND (p.score < #{score} OR (p.score=#{score} AND p.mail_id < #{id})) ORDER BY p.score DESC,p.mail_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
